_comment: Corrections to harvested rows where Wikidata itself is wrong. Applied by scripts/dedupe-places.mjs on every run (after the harvest), so the nightly harvest cannot put the mistake back. A value of null removes that field. Each fix: the fields to set (name, lat, lon, startYear, endYear, placeNote, dateNote), why, and the source checked. A moved pin is also listed in wikidata-coord-exceptions.json so the 25 km lint knows it is deliberate.

q603549.placeNote: Wikidata places this battle in southern Iraq (31.58, 44.50), about 450 km from Nahavand. It was fought at Nahavand, near Hamadan in Iran; the pin is on the town.

q47465940.name: Operation Olive Branch (Afrin)
q47465940.why: Wrong year: the Turkish operation in Afrin ran 20 January – 24 March 2018

q111383245.why: Wrong year: the battle ran 10 October 2023 – 17 February 2024

cur-trip-jerusalem.dateNote: The inn claims to date from 1189, but no record survives to prove it. Most of the present building dates from about 1650 (the date Wikidata gives); the caves behind it are older.
cur-trip-jerusalem.why: Uncertain date: the 1189 claim is the inn's own tradition; Wikidata gives 1650

cur-mali-empire.placeNote: Pinned near Bamako, in the empire's heartland on the upper Niger. Where its capital stood (Niani, Dakajalan or elsewhere) is still debated, so this is not the site of a known city.
cur-mali-empire.why: Uncertain place: an empire has no single point and its capital's site is disputed; Wikidata gives no coordinates

q350.dateNote: A Roman settlement stood here from the 1st century AD. Wikidata gives only the century, so the year shown is approximate.
q350.why: Uncertain date: Wikidata P571 is century-precision ('1st century'), shown as AD 1

cur-sulawesi-art.dateNote: The paintings are dated by the mineral crust that grew over them, which gives only a minimum age: the hunting scene at Leang Bulu' Sipong 4 is at least 44,000 years old, the pig at Leang Tedongnge at least 45,500, and a 2024 study puts a scene at Leang Karampuang at 51,200 years.
cur-sulawesi-art.why: Uncertain date: minimum ages only, and different caves give different ages

cur-chichen-itza.dateNote: Sources differ on when the city began: Wikidata gives 455, while most accounts put its rise around 600 and its height between about 900 and 1100.
cur-chichen-itza.why: Uncertain date: Wikidata P571 is 455, the panel shows c. 600

cur-ife.dateNote: The date shown is the start of Ife's classical age, known for its bronze and terracotta heads. People lived here much earlier (Wikidata says between 1000 and 500 BC), but there is no agreed founding date.
cur-ife.why: Uncertain date: no agreed founding year; Wikidata gives a range in its description only
